title: I Built a game that i actually enjoy playing
author: Unlabeled_
selftext:
test build for the game and leaderboard is live on [https://alrightyth3nn-sys.github.io/flatline/](https://alrightyth3nn-sys.github.io/flatline/) 

  
i used opus 5.5 and gpt astra for some of the motion graphics in the video -- i would love to hear your feedback if you decide to try it out xD

comments.author: Raykas7
comments.body: Great game! A lot of fun! Well done. I think the Machine Gun is a trap...

replies.author: Unlabeled_
replies.body: haha yeah it definitely needs a rework! thank you for your feedback :)

comments.author: No-Meet-6991
comments.body: This is a good example of why ai won't replace game devs. This was lame and lacked all sense of game design lol

replies.author: TheUniverseOrNothing
replies.body: You act like there weren’t bad games before AI. Just because some random user makes a game you don’t like doesn’t mean people aren’t making good AI games.

replies.author: No-Meet-6991
replies.body: It's not a game though? What is your bar for calling something a game?

replies.author: TheUniverseOrNothing
replies.body: You can have two sticks and a ball and call it a game. At this point you’re just being a Reddit incel and need to get a life. It’s not that hard to move on from something you don’t like.

replies.author: aigamedev-ModTeam
replies.body: Be respectul to others and follow reddits guidelines and policies.
